correctness.rationale: For a fixed zero-sum vector, cyclic root i yields m_i=h_max-h_i and s_i,k=h_(i+k)-h_i. Summing the deterministic orbit identity 2 sum_i m_i s_i,k=sum_i s_i,k^2, using zero sum and cyclic invariance gives Cov(M,S_k)=Var(S_k)/2 for every interior k without sign assumptions. Under negated-reversal invariance, reverse cyclic path from lag k to zero to pair (M-S_k,-S_k); centering gives the exact joint reflection. The skew orbit of (2,-1,-1) has nonsymmetric S_1 and is an explicit boundary witness.
